description: Terraforms (0x4E1f41613c9084FdB9E34E11fAE9412427480e56) secondary-market sales, from the Terraform Estimator. Updated monthly.

license.name: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)

verify: shasum -a 256 -c <file>.sha256  (or sha256sum -c; on Windows: Get-FileHash <file> -Algorithm SHA256)

columns.name: sale_time_utc
columns.meaning: when the sale settled, ISO 8601 UTC

columns.name: unix
columns.meaning: the same, as a Unix timestamp (seconds)

columns.name: price
columns.meaning: sale price in the currency column. For kind=bundle this is the ORDER TOTAL, repeated on every parcel in the bundle (OpenSea reports it that way) — divide by legs for a per-parcel figure

columns.name: currency
columns.meaning: ETH (a listing was bought), WETH (an offer was accepted) or BETH (Blur pool ETH, an accepted Blur bid)

columns.name: kind
columns.meaning: single (one parcel in the transaction), sweep (several parcels, each its own order at its own price) or bundle (one order for several parcels)

columns.name: floor_index_eth
columns.meaning: the estimator's daily floor index for that day (12th percentile of clean single-parcel sales over a trailing 14+ day window) — derived, not raw; empty where the index has no value
